body:
Thank you for opening another pull request.

I'm noticing that your contributions are a bit of a scattershot across the codebase. It kind of looks like you're running some kind of bug detection workflow instead of addressing bugs you run into or issues that were reported. 
There's nothing wrong with using static analysis as a guide instead of individual reports, but I'd like to understand where the work is coming from, so please explain what your workflow is and whether it complies with our [AI policy](https://godotengine.org/article/contribution-policy-2026/).

I'd also like to remind you that I [asked you](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/120947#pullrequestreview-4630997469) to use our PR template, and you've since made 3 PRs still ignoring the template.
